title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
job_description: Sr. AI Engineer Job Description Job Description : We are looking for a senior AI Engineer to support the deployment and integration of AI &GenAI solutions into enterprise applications and internal systems. This role is ideal for candidates who are strong in API integration, cloud deployment, and system connectivity, with interest or exposure to AI and GenAI technologies. You will work closely with data scientists, backend developers, and business teams to integrate AI capabilities into real business workflows. Integrate AI services and chatbot APIs into web portals, internal systems, and applications Develop and maintain REST APIs and backend integrations Deploy and maintain applications on AWS cloud infrastructure, including monitoring system performance and ensuring reliability Configure and support services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, IAM Troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and ensure compliance with security and governance standards Collaborate with data scientists, product team, business stakeholders and developers to deliver scalable AI solutions. Requirements : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or related technical field. At least 4 years working experience related AI engineering and API integration job Hands-on experience in API integration and backend development Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON AWS cloud experience, and familiar with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, CloudWatch Knowledge of Python, Node.js, or JavaScript Understanding of authentication methods such as OAuth2, SSO etc
